name: Cafe ma cherie -Ikemen Cafe no Otome-
original_name: Cafe ma cherie -イケメンカフェの乙女-
source:
Cafe ma cherie, where you can work with handsome guys.
The protagonist who ended up working here after an encounter is actually...a girl?!

[From App Store]
